line: Hands on you like my controller
vault_lines: Hands on you like my controller
meaning: Sosa has previously mentioned in interviews how he is a big fan of video games. He prefers to play xbox over playstation and his favourite video game is Mortal Kombat. He is even the ceo of a youtube gaming channel called GloNavyGaming.

line: Jump on a boat and sa-a-ail Feelin’ like Johnny Depp
vault_lines: Jump on a boat and sa-a-ail
meaning: Chief Keef is referring to Johnny Depp’s role in the Pirates of the Caribbean film series, where Depp plays the lead role of Captain Jack Sparrow.
